notes: I2 rests on PG (Pt nanoparticles on graphene oxide, Pt 18.9 wt% by EDS, main p. 4, Section 3.3, Fig. S6), whose H2 uptake at 77 K up to ~1.1 bar is measured on the ASAP 2020 (Fig. 6). PG is treated as a metal-decorated carbon (graphene_oxide class, metal_element Pt), included under §3; the paper gives no C wt% for PG, so carbon being the majority by mass is not numerically confirmed. HPG0 (HKUST-1) and HPG5/HPG10 (MOF with 5 or 10 wt% added GO) are MOF-majority and are not carbon sorbents; all 298 K data (Fig. 8 gravimetric to 80 bar, Fig. S11) are on these MOF samples only. I1 for PG relies on the ASAP 2020, a volumetric instrument, though the paper does not name the method; the gravimetric Rubotherm measurement is explicit but covers MOF samples only. I4 is met by BET areas of the MOF samples (Table S2); PG has no numerical area ("significantly low and negligible porosity", Section 3.4). Main-text area units are printed as cm2 g-1, a typo for m2 g-1 per Table S2. No retraction, review or duplicate-data statement found.
